method: for each truth note: among the outputs with the same pitch starting within +/-150 ms, take the nearest; delta = out.start - truth.start; report the median. spoken counts the notes that had any output starting within the window, pitch ignored.
note: readings only. A single sample, or a subset a tool chose to answer, is a point, not a constant: it goes into align.json only if a second sample of the same condition reproduces it.
